name: clawd-pet
description: Clawd, the Claude pet, sits right above your prompt, on the right, with its laptop: it types while Claude works and falls asleep (Zzz) when you are idle.

idleSeconds.title: Seconds before the pet falls asleep
idleSeconds.description: How long with no typing and no running turn before Clawd goes to sleep.

color.title: Clawd's color
color.description: Pick a color for Clawd. To use your own, fill in "Custom color" below.

customColor.title: Custom color
customColor.description: Any hex color, like #00BCD4. When filled in it wins over the color picked above; leave it empty to use that one.
